title: was/were
summary: Прошедшее время глагола **be**: **was** (I / he / she / it) и **were** (we / you / they) — «был, была, были, находился».
ru:
## Что это такое
**was / were** — прошедшая форма **am / is / are**. Рассказываем, кем или где кто-то был, каким что-то было.
> I **am** tired now. → I **was** tired last night. — Вчера вечером я устала.
> Where **is** Ann? → Where **was** Ann yesterday? — Где Анна была вчера?
> You **are** late. → You **were** late yesterday. — Вчера ты опоздал.

## Какую форму выбрать
- **was** — с **I / he / she / it** и одним предметом или человеком
- **were** — с **we / you / they** и множественным числом
> The weather **was** good last week. — На прошлой неделе погода была хорошей.
> We **were** hungry after the journey. — После поездки мы были голодны.
> My parents **were** at home. — Мои родители были дома.

## Отрицание
**wasn't** (= was not), **weren't** (= were not)
> The hotel **wasn't** expensive. — Отель был недорогим.
> They **weren't** here last Sunday. — В прошлое воскресенье их здесь не было.

## Вопрос
Переставляем **was / were** перед подлежащим.
> **Was** the weather good? — Погода была хорошей?
> **Were** you at the party? — Ты был на вечеринке?
> Why **were** you late? — Почему ты опоздал?

## Краткие ответы
> Were you late? — **Yes, I was.** / **No, I wasn't.**
> Was Ted at work? — **Yes, he was.** / **No, he wasn't.**
> Were they at the party? — **Yes, they were.** / **No, they weren't.**

## Слова-подсказки прошлого
**yesterday, last night, last week, last year, ago, in 2010, when I was a child**
> Last year Rachel **was** 22, so she **is** 23 now.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I were tired.~~ → I **was** tired.
- ~~They was at home.~~ → They **were** at home.
- ~~Was you at work?~~ → **Were** you at work?
- ~~I didn't was there.~~ → I **wasn't** there. (с be did не нужен)
- ~~Yesterday I am at home.~~ → Yesterday I **was** at home.
en:
## What is it?
**was / were** are the past forms of **am / is / are**. We use them to say where or how somebody or something was in the past.
> I **am** tired now. → I **was** tired last night.
> Where **is** Ann? → Where **was** Ann yesterday?
> You **are** late. → You **were** late yesterday.

## Which form?
- **was** — with **I / he / she / it** and singular nouns
- **were** — with **we / you / they** and plural nouns
> The weather **was** good last week.
> We **were** hungry after the journey.
> My parents **were** at home.

## Negative
**wasn't** (= was not), **weren't** (= were not)
> The hotel **wasn't** expensive.
> They **weren't** here last Sunday.

## Questions
Put **was / were** before the subject.
> **Was** the weather good?
> **Were** you at the party?
> Why **were** you late?

## Short answers
> Were you late? — **Yes, I was.** / **No, I wasn't.**
> Was Ted at work? — **Yes, he was.** / **No, he wasn't.**
> Were they at the party? — **Yes, they were.** / **No, they weren't.**

## Past time words
**yesterday, last night, last week, last year, ago, when I was a child**

## Common mistakes
- ~~I were tired.~~ → I **was** tired.
- ~~They was at home.~~ → They **were** at home.
- ~~I didn't was there.~~ → I **wasn't** there.
structure:
## Утверждение, отрицание, вопрос
| Подлежащее | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | I was | I wasn't | Was I ...? |
| he / she / it | he was | he wasn't | Was he ...? |
| we / you / they | we were | we weren't | Were we ...? |

## Настоящее → прошедшее
| Present | Past |
|---|---|
| am / is | **was** |
| are | **were** |

## Краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Да | Нет |
|---|---|---|
| Was I / he / she / it ...? | Yes, I / he / she / it **was**. | No, I / he / she / it **wasn't**. |
| Were we / you / they ...? | Yes, we / you / they **were**. | No, we / you / they **weren't**. |

## Формулы
> Подлежащее + **was / were** + ...
> Подлежащее + **wasn't / weren't** + ...
> **Was / Were** + подлежащее + ...?
> Where **were** you yesterday? — I **was** at work.

## Слова времени
- **yesterday**, **last night / week / month / year**
- **ago**: two days ago
- **in** + год: in 2010
